description: This file contains functions for handling attachments in the Notesnook project, including downloading, saving, decrypting, and previewing image attachments, as well as checking attachment upload status.

classes.name: Attachment
classes.description: Imported from @notesnook/core, representing an attachment object.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Internal function to retrieve attachment data and decrypt key for further processing.

methods.name: saveAttachment
methods.description: Downloads an attachment by hash and saves it locally.

methods.name: downloadAttachment
methods.description: Downloads and decrypts an attachment, returning data in specified format (blob, base64, text).

methods.name: checkAttachment
methods.description: Checks the upload status of an attachment and marks it as failed if necessary.

methods.name: previewImageAttachment
methods.description: Displays a preview of an image attachment in a lightbox modal.
